You must navigate 150 screens, each of which is constructed of platforms, ladders, poles, and rope. Use the elements of the screen to collect all of the treasure and move on to the next area. However, there are a large number of enemies out to stop you including rolling skulls, spiders, snakes, Aztec guards, scorpions, and spikes. Touch any of these hazards and it's Game Over. Luckily, you can pick up new abilities along the way, like walking through enemies and killing an attacker with one touch. Try to collect all of the Aztec's treasure that you can in MONTEZUMA'S RETURN.
Monty on the Run

This is a homebrew game, run on Game Boy Color. Original version: Jason Perkins and Terry Droid - Gremlin Graphics. Commodore 16/Plus4, 1986. Created with GB-Studio 2.0.0 beta5!

Monty having escaped from prison and now superfit so that he can quickly make his way to freedom through many hideouts and secret locations. The gold coins located throughout the game must be collected by Monty to enable hime to escape to freedom.

The Game Boy Color version is based on Jason Perkins's Commodore 16 conversion.
Title music from Auf Wiedersehen Monty.

Also available for download in .CIA format for the Nintendo 3DS virtual console!
Moomin's Tale
Moomin's Tale (Moomin no Daibouken in Japan) is an action platform game developed and released by Sunsoft for the Game Boy Color. It is based on the Finnish franchise the Moomins.
Moorhuhn 2: Die Jagd Geht Weiter

Moorhuhn 2: Die Jagd geht weiter is the second handheld game in the franchise. It contains a simplified version of the console/PC version and adds several other game modes.

• Moorhuhn 2 is the traditional game variant in which the player must shoot at Moorhühner flying by, being awarded more points for hitting birds farther away.
• In Spinnen spinnen, spiders are hanging by threads and must be hit for points. Hitting them sends the thread spinning, making them harder to hit until they come to rest. A hit must be made within a few seconds or a life is lost. Surviving an entire round adds an additional critter in the next one.
• Hau das Huhn is a Whac-a-Mole variant in which Moorhühner appear randomly in four different locations and must be hit for points.
• In Die Moorballons, balloons of various colours are sent flying across the screen, with points being awarded for hitting only the balloons of a given colour.
Moorhuhn 3: ...Es Gibt Huhn!

Moorhuhn 3 is the third game in the franchise to appear on the Game Boy Color. It includes a simplified variant of the console/PC game and adds a number of additional mini-games.

• Moorhuhn 3 is the traditional game in which the player must shoot at birds flying by.
• Moortris is a Tetris variant (also available as an easter egg in the main version) in which the blocks move from left to right.
• Fische versenken (also available as a standalone game for PC) simulates dynamite fishing. The dynamite is ignited by pressing a button, but there is no strategy - the score is entirely random.
• Bandits is a Bank Panic variant. Doors open to reveal Moorhühner - the player must shoot at bandits carrying revolvers or explosives while avoiding shooting friendly birds holding flowers.

All games are played for high score which is saved to battery-backed RAM.
Mortal Kombat 4

Two fighters enter the arena; the winner will move on in the tournament, the other will be dead. This tournament for control of Earth has been going on for centuries and continues in MORTAL KOMBAT 4. Choose from eight different characters: Fujin, Liu Kang, Sub Zero, Tanya, Quan Chi, Raiden, Reiko, Shinnok, Scorpion, and a few hidden characters as well. Each character has unique moves, combinations, and fatalities, and when you properly execute a fatality, a short animated reenactment plays. Throughout the game, there are special Kombat Kodes that are exclusive to the Game Boy Color, and you'll also get quite a bit of in-game speech. If you think you are the strongest fighter, prove it with MORTAL KOMBAT 4.
Mothballs

Woof!

A look into the daily life of a dog.

(Yep, that's it)

(Nothing else to see here)

Retro Game Boy style aesthetics with short mini-games!
Short ~10 mins of gameplay
Nothing spooky here. Only CUTE and ADORABLE dog moments!!!
Made in 2 days for THIS HOUSE WANTS TO BE EMPTY JAM with a mouse!
Motocross Maniacs 2

The action of motocross comes to the Game Boy Color with MOTOCROSS MANIACS 2. Hop on a motorcycle and hit the bumps, jumps, and loops of each track. Try to earn the fastest time in the Time Trial mode or take on five different tracks in the Championship mode. No matter how you play, there are power-ups scattered throughout the tracks including nitros, mini riders, jets, gasoline, super suspension, speed, and radials. If you don't like any of the 10 packaged tracks, you can create your own with the Track Editor option. There are a total of 255 obstacles and 32 different items that can be placed on any of the three tracks that you create. Once you have a masterpiece, share it with a friend via a link cable. Get motocross action with MOTOCROSS MANIACS 2.
Mr. Driller

Mr Driller is a real-time puzzle game that relies solely on quick-thinking and a bit of planning. Gameplay is a combination of Tetris and Boulder Dash: You have to drill down through multi-colored blocks to reach the bottom while avoiding the consequences of reckless drilling (blocks may fall on you and crush you).
Mr. Nutz

Yeti wants to rule over the entire world, so he is using his magical powers to turn it into a large mass of ice. There is only one person who can save the day: Mr. Nutz the Squirrel. You take control of Mr. Nutz as he runs, jumps, swims, and flies through six different worlds. Along the way, you must collect acorns, coins, extra lives, and extra energy. Getting through the levels and collecting the goodies is no walk in the park, as there are plenty of bad guys waiting to stop you. Luckily, Mr. Nutz can dispose of them by jumping on their heads or whipping them with his giant tail. Will you be able to find all of the secrets and defeat Yeti in MR. NUTZ?
Ms. Pac-Man: Special Color Edition

All of the action and fun of the first feminist arcade game can be put in the palm of your hand with MS. PAC-MAN: Special Color Edition. You take control of the yellow disk adorned with lipstick and a pink bow, better known as the lovely Ms. Pac-Man. The goal is to guide her around the maze and eat all of the dots, avoiding the four ghosts that chase you. There are power pellets located in each corner of the maze which, when eaten, turn the ghosts blue. Once this happens, the ghosts can be eaten. Occasionally, fruit will float into the maze, which can be munched for extra points. If your friends want to play along, there is an alternating Two-Player mode. As an additional bonus, a complete version of SUPER PAC-MAN is included on the cartridge. Play as the first female arcade hero in MS. PAC-MAN: Special Color Edition.
MTV Sports: Pure Ride

MTV Sports: Pure Ride is a snowboarding game for the Game Boy Color. Unlike the PlayStation version it's completely 2D and differs in game modes. The Game Boy Color version comes with tour challenge, half-pipe competition and a training mode. The tour challenge features fictional courses from all over the world where you have to race downhill and perform tricks. Half-pipe competition is played in a different perspective and is focused more on performing tricks. IN the training mode you can practice tricks at your own leisure. There are 23 possible tricks in the game.
MTV Sports: Skateboarding Featuring Andy Macdonald

MTV Sports: Skateboarding Featuring Andy Macdonald is an isometric skateboarding game for the Game Boy Color. You can choose to play 4 different skateboarders, including Andy Macdonald. You can grind objects, perform ollies, grabs and 360s. There are 18 different cities to stunt around in. You score points through performing tricks and achieving objectives such as finding MTV icons. Unlocked cities can be played in at will in the Free-Skate mode.
MTV Sports: T.J. Lavin's Ultimate BMX

MTV SPORTS: T.J. Lavin's Ultimate BMX puts the action of riding a stunt BMX bike in the palm of your hand. The game offers six different professional riders: T.J. Lavin, Fuzzy Hall, Chris Duncan, Mike Ardelean, Jamie Bestwick, or Colin Winkelmann. Try to pull off the most spectacular stunts in three different play modes: Vert, Street, and Dirt. Vert has the player performing tricks on a halfpipe; Street has the player navigate a course with ramps, fun boxes, and other objects while executing tricks to win the judges attention; and the Dirt event puts the player on a dirt track to try to pull off big tricks without biting the dust. Master the skills of professional BMX in MTV SPORTS: T.J. Lavin's Ultimate BMX.
Mud Warriors
Mud Warriors is a narrative adventure game with a focus on story and exploration. It is also a Gameboy adaptation of Ryan's original text adventure game.
Murder Mansion

Murder Mansion is a horror game that tries to bring back memories of old point and click games. In this game, you play as Ashley Manson, a young journalist who engages herself in an ominous situation.

The story takes place in 20th century. A rumor has been spread between people about some disappearances. Some say they're murdered, others say it's a supernatural phenomenon.

The main character, "Ashley Manson", a young and active journalist, tries to solve this mystery by herself. She discovers that this disappearances are somehow connected to the old mansion in the woods. So she goes there to investigate, but she doesn't know what a terrible fate awaits her...

Be careful on your journey. Listen to the sounds, if you are hiding, no one can see you. if you heard footsteps, this means a thread is coming. hide immediately.
Muteki Ou Tri-Zenon

An exhilarating action simulation game in which the "invincible" Trizenon defeats the enemy robots of Zenon Palace, which has begun to invade the earth. With graphics approaching anime, attractive characters are appearing one after another! Easy operation that even children can easily play!
My Friendly Little Island

My Friendly Little Island is a cute game about personal growth and making friends. It starts out as a slow, simplistic adventure game. However, with every new skill you unlock, the game’s dynamics change more and more into a fast-paced platformer.

 - Unlock new skills to fully explore your island
 - Help new friends and populate your village
 - Feel the music become livelier with every new villager
 - Change your looks with cosmetic items
 - Experience the day-night cycle
 - 30-60 minutes of playtime until the credits roll
 - Save feature unlocked early into the game
 - Lots of coconuts :)
My Saturday Grounded
Tim is grounded this Saturday. But his mom is heading out to see someone. Maybe this means Tim can sneak out and see someone too...
Myte Byte

Myte Byte is a small action-puzzle game made for real Gameboy hardware that will challenge any gamer's puzzle solving skills.

This game features 35 levels meant to test your reflexes, options in the menu to adjust the game setting difficulty (for the journalists), 8 bosses to rumble toe to toe with as well as secret files to recover from the evil bosses. The color pallet is optimized for a balance between GBC/GBA.

It' important to note that you cannot save in game as this is a GBC title without a save battery. There is also no save function on the original DMG Gameboy system due to the limitations.
Mythri

Mythri was an upcoming American-developed, Japanese-style RPG for the Game Boy Advance. Originally for the Game Boy Color, development switched gears after the GBA was released. The game was in development by Team XKalibur from around 2000 to 2005, when it was officially cancelled.
Nakayoshi Cooking Series 1: Oishii Cake-ya-san

A series for moms and girls who will be able to master recipes and tips on how to cook while playing games. The first theme is "cake"! The menu includes Christmas cakes, shortcakes, apple pies, cheesecakes, cream puffs, chocolate cakes, bound cakes, chocolate chip cookies, die-cut cookies, and hot cakes. There are two game modes, "scenario mode" and "funny making mode". Includes two games, "Search for ingredients" to search for ingredients for cooking to advance the game, and "Cooking" to make sweets according to the recipe.
Nakayoshi Cooking Series 2: Oishii Panya-san

The second cooking series where you can enjoy playing and learning cooking. The theme this time is bread. There are 11 types of menu: melon bread, donuts, croissant, anpan, butter roll, curry bread, ham roll, drawing bread, Yamagata bread, raisin bread, and French bread. There are two game modes: a "material search mode" that searches for ingredients for cooking that are lacking in the recipe, and a "cooking mode" that makes bread in order according to the recipe. Find the ingredients for the recipe, cook according to the procedure, and get the final overall evaluation. It's 100% practical because it gives you easy-to-understand advice on how to make it!
Nakayoshi Cooking Series 3: Tanoshii Obentou

The third cooking series where you can enjoy playing and learning cooking. The purpose of this time is to make a bento box with themes such as "for cherry blossom viewing" and "nostalgic". There are more than 170 types of bento boxes that can be made by combining staple foods and side dishes! You can also create new side dishes by combining ingredients. If you clear it to the end, you can freely make a bento with side dishes! It might be a good idea to have a lunch box show with your friends. A lot of comical and cute mini games such as cutting, baking, and simmering according to the rhythm are also included!
Nakayoshi Cooking Series 4: Tanoshii Dessert

The 4th cooking series! Let's make dessert! !! Once you have decided on the dessert you want to make, go out to the town to get the ingredients and recipes. Once you have all the ingredients, start making desserts and enjoy cooking while playing mini games! When it's done, choose decorations and toppings and serve. The desserts made for each stage are evaluated and the results affect the event. There are more than 60 types of dessert main toppings and decorations, and there are many types of combinations! Let's make a delicious dessert aiming for a true ending!
Nakayoshi Cooking Series 5: Cake o Tsukurou

A heartwarming story about Komugi-chan and Usako, who describe friendship, love, and growth through cooking. You can make your own cake by choosing your favorite combination from many combinations. You can enjoy the decoration pattern by decorating the cake made by selecting the cake type, dough, ingredients, and cream with decoration items. Also, they are reflected in the cross section of the cake. In addition to "Story Mode" where you can enjoy 8 stories, "Mini Game Mode" and "Layout Mode" as "Furoku Mode", "Databank" where you can check the information of the cake you made and the character settings and print out.
Nakayoshi Pet Series 1: Kawaii Hamster

Nakayoshi Pet Series 1: Kawaii Hamster is the first of many portable pets games. Imagine a bulky, less active Tamagotchi inching up in battery consumption and obnoxious sounds.

It shows a lot of realistic and agile movements and cute facial expressions that you can enjoy as if you were really breeding.
Nakayoshi Pet Series 2: Kawaii Usagi

A pet breeding simulation based on a rabbit, which is popular among small animals. There are three types of rabbits, the real white rabbit, the dwarf fly-on, and the Netherlands dwarf, and the more you get along with each other by feeding them, the more patterns of gestures will increase. The operation method is a command selection method using icons, and anyone can play directly. Even children can enjoy it with peace of mind because they do not dare to use raw expressions such as rabbits getting sick or dying. Also, since it is compatible with a pocket printer, it is possible to print images of "memorial albums". You can also use the communication cable to go to your friend's rabbit's house or fortune about the day.
Nakayoshi Pet Series 3: Kawaii Koinu

"Nakayoshi Pet Series" where genuine pets can be kept in GB. Five types of miniature dachshund, Labrador, Shiba Inu, Pomeranian, and Maltese are now available. The more you take care of discipline, training, feeding, cleaning, walking, etc. such as "prone" and "hands", the more patterns of emotions and emotions will increase. The walking course is riverbed, shopping street, housing complex, etc. Adult puppies can also be invited to participate in events such as dog shows and Frispeedock Championships.
Nakayoshi Pet Series 4: Kawaii Koneko

"Nakayoshi Pet Series" where genuine pets can be kept in GB. Four popular pet stores and calico cats are here! Feed and clean the kittens to raise the "good friend level" and "care points", and as the points increase, the types of food and play will increase. There is also a "cat show", which depends on the height of the "good friend level" and the condition of the kitten, so it is difficult to win the championship. Comes with "memorial album", "fortune-telling", "communication" and "printer".
Nakayoshi Pet Series 5: Kawaii Hamster 2

The fifth in the Nakayoshi Pet series. The facial expressions and gestures of the hamster are more expressed. In addition to Golden, Jungarian, and Roborovski, there are two types of hamsters that can be bred: Campbell and Chinese. By editing the main character, you can enter the name, gender, and face, and you can reflect yourself in the game and participate in the event with the hamster. A pseudo time flow is added, and the transition of time from morning to night affects the behavior of hamsters. Items can be obtained at pet stores using "Nakayoshi Points". It supports communication cables, so you can send your hamster to your friend's hamster's house.
NASCAR 2000

Prove you can handle the thunder! Featuring more drivers - Dale Earnhardt Jr., Tony Stewart and Adam Petty join the field of 33 NASCAR drivers and 7 legends. 18 licensed NASCAR tracks, now including Homestead-Miami Speedway. New TV and Crew Chief audio - Bob Jenkins and Benny Parsons in the booth plus Crew Chief and Spotter assistance. Wheel-to-wheel NASCAR competition - go head-to-head on the split-screen! Six driving views, including behind the wheel. Multiple modes - Quick Race, Single Race, or Championship Season.
NASCAR Challenge

The thrill of victory and the agony of smashing into another car comes to the Game Boy Color in NASCAR CHALLENGE. Hop in and take on the best NASCAR has to offer including Jeff Gordon, Dale Jarret, and Rusty Wallace. Try to master Topeka, Sonoma, and Seneca raceways in the Practice mode, and when you're ready for some competition, try to survive six laps on any of the tracks. To prevail in the championship, you will have to try to win the pole position on each track and beat the pack to the finish line. Depending on how well you finish in each race, you are awarded points. The driver with the most points at the end of all three races is declared the champion. Can you handle all of the excitement and action in NASCAR CHALLENGE?
NASCAR Heat

Fans of stock car racing, get ready to take on the challenges of NASCAR HEAT for the Game Boy Color. Play as or against 10 stock car racing legends like Dale Earnhardt, Jeff Gordon, Bobby Labonte, and Dale Jarrett. After you pick a driver, you can learn the twists and turns of each track with the Beat the Heat mode, where each of the 10 professional drivers give the player challenges to complete. When you are ready for some competition, get after the other drivers in a Quick Race, or try to become NASCAR champion in the Championship mode. No matter which mode you choose, you will have to make strategic decisions to conquer each race. Most notably, determining when to make a pit stop can win or lose a race. Get all of the racing action you want with NASCAR HEAT.
NASCAR Racers

Based on the Fox cartoon series of the same name, NASCAR RACERS is a glimpse of what NASCAR will be like in the future. You can choose from five different cars, each with its own abilities that increase during the course of the race including one car that becomes invincible and another that gains a huge burst of speed. After you choose the correct car for your driving style, hit one of the 20 tracks available in the game. While you're on the track, you need to keep an eye out for the oil slicks, water puddles, and random debris that will slow down or damage your car. If the car sustains too much damage, then the race is over, for you anyway. Luckily, there is a truck to refuel and repair your vehicle. Will you be able to cross the finish line in NASCAR RACERS?
NBA 3 on 3 Featuring Kobe Bryant

Experience the wide-open nature of three-on-three basketball with NBA 3-ON-3 FEATURING KOBE BRYANT. You can choose your squad from all of the NBA teams that include actual rosters. Once you have chosen your favorite team, play a Pick-Up game to get accustomed to the game style and controls. When you are ready for some competition, try to win the NBA championship in a 14, 28, 56, or 82-game Season mode. If you don't want to waste your time playing a full season, you can go straight to the Playoffs. No matter what mode you play, the rules of the game can be adjusted, including shot clock violations, backcourt violations, and the maximum number of points that can be scored. If you want to put yourself into the game, you can with the Create-A-Player option. Now you can try to conquer the NBA in NBA 3-ON-3 FEATURING KOBE BRYANT.
NBA Hoopz

Are you ready to hoop it up with the pros? Do you have the skills to make it to the next level and take your opponent out like the trash? Are your moves too much to handle? Well, then you might just be ready for the most extreme three-on-three action that videogaming has ever seen. In the bold tradition of arcade classics like NBA JAM, NBA HOOPZ focuses on totally unrealistic, terrifically acrobatic basketball. Fly through the air as you pull off summersault dunks, mind-blowing alley-oops, and graceful outside jumpers. There are no complicated plays or boring rules to hold you back do what you have to do to wrestle the ball away from the other team and put it in the hole. Shaquille O'Neal takes the spotlight in this one, but there are plenty of other NBA stars to play as (though some need to be unlocked by winning games). Choose which players you want to play on your NBA franchise, then jump it up and see who's the best.
NBA In The Zone

This is the first in the NBA in the Zone games, which is considered a true simulation of the NBA. There are 29 teams to choose from with a full compliment of rosters from the 1996 season and a plethora of offensive and defensive plays to use against their opponents with trick shots like behind-the-back passes, skyhooks, alley-oops, fade-away jumpers and of course the slam dunk.

There are, however, only five players from each team on the court at one time, similar to NBA Jam. The game also supports an advanced A.I. and is rendered in 3-D polygons. There are two modes to choose from, Exhibition and Playoff.
NBA In the Zone 2000

It's called "The Zone." Marcus Camby found it in last year's NBA Playoffs. We took it from him and put it in this box. Open it up. Shoot the lights out! New dunking animations. Let it fly with the game on the line! All-new freethrow design - don't brick it! All-new camera angles! Smooth animations and jump shots!
NBA Jam '99

Arcade basketball action comes to the Game Boy Color in NBA JAM '99. Enjoy a two-on-two basketball game with no rules using your favorite NBA players. Use the Practice mode to work on your moves, and when you're ready to compete, take on a Quick Play game or become the champion after playing through the grueling NBA Season. If the hassles of the season become too much, just skip to the Playoffs. No matter how you play, all of the classic NBA JAM gameplay remains intact. Players can make five-point baskets by shooting from Hotspots, or receive a temporary stats-boost by collecting the power-ups that occasionally appear on the court. If you are looking for a different kind of basketball game, try NBA JAM '99.
NBA Jam 2001

Get even more arcade-style basketball action with NBA JAM 2001. Choose from all 29 NBA teams -- over 140 professional players in all. Get used to the controls and action with the Practice mode, and when you are ready for some real action, try to become NBA champion by playing through the Season. If the Season is giving you a headache, you can skip it and go straight to the Playoffs. No matter what mode you play in, there will be plenty of fastbreaks and rim-rattling jams. Throw even more action into the game with the Fun mode that includes Hot Spots, Hang Time, Half Court Dunks, and On Fire. You can also unlock secret teams like the East and West All-Star teams. Get all of the basketball action you want in the palm of your hand with NBA JAM 2001.
NBA Showtime: NBA on NBC

Take on all of the action of two-on-two basketball with no rules in NBA SHOWTIME: NBA on NBC. Choose from all 29 NBA teams, featuring over 100 professional players then hit the hardwood and work on your moves in the Practice mode. When you want some competition, work your way through the Season to the Championship. If you don't want to bother with the Season, skip it, and leap right into the Playoffs. With over 30 different slam-dunk animations, you are going to see something new every time you play. If you can get a player to sink three buckets in a row, watch him light up the scoreboard while he is on fire. If you enjoy wild basketball action, you will love the action in NBA SHOWTIME: NBA on NBC.
Nesmos Uranai
Fortune-telling the Nesmos vending machine used at the game impact event! ?? Put money in, turn the handle with the cross key, and then go out of the white box for fortune-telling results.
Net de Get: Mini-Game @ 100

A collection of mini games that you will definitely be addicted to. 15 types of mini games of various genres such as puzzles, actions, and reflexes are recorded. As the name "Get on the Net" suggests, you can download a new mini-game using the mobile system GB! The games you can get depend on the play points of the mini-games that are included from the beginning. Get all the games! A handy game that's perfect for when you have a little time or want to kill time.
Network Boukenki Bugsite: Alpha
Network Boukenki Bugsite: Alpha is a Role-Playing game, developed by Kaze and published by Smilesoft, which was released in Japan in 2001.
Network Boukenki Bugsite: Beta
Network Boukenki Bugsite: Beta is a Role-Playing game, developed by Kaze and published by Smilesoft, which was released in Japan in 2001.
NFL Blitz

NFL BLITZ is the NFL at its finest, featuring easy to run plays and unparalleled action all in breakneck speed. With no penalties, no substitutions and nowhere to hide, NFL BLITZ is more than a game, it's an NFL highlight film! Featuring all the bone-crunching, fast-paced, hard-hitting football fun you expect from the arcade hit - only smaller! Every one of the 30 NFL teams are included in this 7-on-7 pigskin extravaganza! Feel free to mash the competition using each of the 18 offensive plays and 9 defensive plays.
NFL Blitz 2000

NFL BLITZ 2000 brings fast-paced, no-holds-barred football action to the field. Rather than offering a standard football game, NFL BLITZ 2000 changes the rules a little. The game is played seven-on-seven, and it takes 30-yards to get a first down. But probably the most important rule change is that there are no penalties. When you start the game, you have the choice of playing in the Arcade or Season mode. Arcade has you pick a team and try to defeat all of the other teams in the league, while in the Season mode, you take your team through the grueling NFL season in hopes of making the playoffs and winning the Super Bowl. No matter how you play the game, you will not miss a second of the action, thanks to three different camera angles. Try to keep your helmet on while playing NFL BLITZ 2000.
NFL Blitz 2001

If you're a football fanatic looking for arcade-style gridiron action, then NFL BLITZ 2001 from Midway is right up your alley. Take all the tiresome rules and regulations of standard football and throw them out the window BLITZ is fast, furious, and out of control. Real-life NFL stars are modeled here in a brutish, cartoon-inspired fashion and their burly physiques are perfect for inflicting damage on your opponents. Listen and laugh at humorous commentary from the in-game announcer and garner helpful hints from the sexy cheerleaders as you attack your way upfield towards the goal line. And you can savor all the bone-crushing pigskin mayhem again and again in a helmet-cracking replay mode. You'll watch in awe as your team catches fire after a series of excellent plays. Compete in four stadiums new to the franchise like the "Stadium of the Future," watch the action from a range of angles (including Blimp view), go head-to-head in Single-Player competition, and much more.
NHL 2000

Professional hockey comes to the Game Boy Color with NHL 2000. You can choose from all of the NHL teams, including the expansion Atlanta Thrashers. Play an Exhibition game to work on your tactics and strategies, and when you are ready for long-term competition, try to endure an 82-game Season, or just skip straight to the Playoffs. While in the game, you will have to learn when to make line changes and determine when it's a good time to pull the goalie. In addition to these tactical decisions, you must also deal with penalties and infractions including offsides, two-line passes, and icing. However, you can customize the game by turning off certain rules and setting the referee's strictness. In addition, there are three different difficulty levels. Will you be able to claim the Stanley Cup? The only way to find out is by playing NHL 2000.
NHL Blades of Steel

Strap on your skates and hit the ice with NHL BLADES OF STEEL. Play with or against all of the teams in the NHL in the Exhibition mode, where you can get your bearings and learn winning tactics. Then, put those tactics to the test in the Season mode and try to win the Stanley Cup. If you don't like the ups and downs of Season play, go straight to the Playoffs. And when your friends question your dominance in the rink, go after them in the Two-Player link cable option. If the game ends in a tie, you will have to try to win it all in a shootout. No matter what mode you play, you must win the fights because if you lose, you go to the box. However, you can use the Practice mode to work on your fighting skills as well as your shootout technique. Will you be able to handle the action of NHL BLADES OF STEEL?
NHL Blades of Steel 2000

Try to win Lord Stanley's Cup in NHL BLADES OF STEEL 2000. You can play with or against any NHL team and use the Exhibition mode to learn the controls and practice your skills. When you want to test your tactics, enter the race for the Stanley Cup in the Season mode. If getting through a Season is a bigger time investment than you want, just skip it and go straight to the Playoffs. When a friend challenges your domination of the rink, put him in his place with the link cable Two-Player mode. No matter what mode you play, you will have to win the game in a shootout if it's tied at the end of regulation. And if you get into a fight and lose, you will have to sit in the penalty box. Try to become the greatest hockey player in the world with NHL BLADES OF STEEL 2000.
NickToons Racing

Characters from your favorite Nicktoons are motorin' for victory in this Game Boy Color racer! Get on the Rugrats track... watch out for those Angry Beavers ... steer clear of SpongeBob SquarePants. Race on multiple tracks based on your favorite Nicktoons - Tommy, SpongeBob SquarePants, Eliza, The Angry Beavers, CatDog and Arnold. Whether you play alone or against a friend, it looks like a wild ride ahead!
Ninja Gaiden Shadow DX

Ninja Gaiden Shadow is a unique entry in the Ninja Gaiden series that was released exclusively for the original Game Boy. 
Guide Ryu Hayabusa through five stages packed with pure ninja action and save the world from the evil Emporer Garuda!

This new remastered version enhances the visual experience by giving it a new coat of color!
Nintama Rantarou: Ninjutsu Gakuen ni Nyuugaku Shiyou no Dan

Let's practice ninjutsu (mini game) at Ninjutsu Gakuen! The game is divided into a "training volume" and a "competition volume". In "Training Volume", you can choose your favorite character from Rantaro, Kirimaru, and Shinpei to play the game. Each shinobi has its own characteristics, so let's identify and challenge each individuality! In "Battle Volume", you can play CPU battles and 2P battles using communication cables. The number of characters that can be used increases with the "Training Volume". There are five types of games: "jumping", "gunning", "shuriken", "foot rowing", and "swimming".
Nisemon: Puzzle da Mon!

The popular 4-panel manga serialized in "Comic BomBom" has become a game! The purpose is to rescue the companions trapped in the mysterious energy hall by Warmon. There are 3 characters that the player can take. Select a "character that can be used as a weapon" according to the situation, defeat the nasty "enemy character" on the stage, and rescue the "rescue character". Since the attack method, speed, and behavior change depending on the selected Nisemon, it is a real pleasure to freely use various strategies. You can also collect the characters that appear in the game as a picture book. Since the back information is also posted in the picture book, you can fully enjoy the charm of the Nisemon character.
No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking

No Fear Downhill Mountain Biking is a mountain bike video game released in 1999 on PlayStation and 2001 on the Game Boy Color, Dreamcast version been planned but never released.
An extreme sports game, the mountain bike consists of mountain tracks from circuits around the world of varying difficulty. The game was inspired by tracks including San Francisco's Telegraph Hill and New Zealand's Matukituki Rapids. 
The game has eight different riders and a number of tracks for the bikes to descend.
Noble Blood

This is an entry into the Shacknews Gamejam 2023, with the theme "Blood".

It's a murder mystery with a bit of styling from Thief: The Dark Project
Nobunaga no Yabou: Game Boy Han 2

The warlords start moving lively! A masterpiece depicting the Sengoku period is powered up! Now is the time to fulfill the great ambitions of Nobunaga Oda, who has been scattered in the midst of his ambitions by making full use of his unique warlords and doing his best in strategy and tactics! "Nobunaga's Ambition: Sengoku Gunyuden" is now available on Game Boy! !! The scenario is equipped with two episodes, "Gunyu Wari" in 1560 and "Nobunaga's Ambition" in 1582. There are more than 400 warlords. Equipped with "field battle" and "siege battle" modes.
Noctambulo

In the heights of the Andes, young Bennie tries to enter a mysterious night club in order to fin his lost love. The problem is he’s pretty wasted and everything seems to conspire against him. Noctambulo is an adventure platformer for Game Boy Color with a lot of flavor. The demo allows you to play the fist chapter in full. The rest is in active development. Thank you for your support
Noddy and the Birthday Party

It's Big-Ears' Birthday! Can you help Noddy collect things for the party? Explore Toyland and take part in 10 exciting adventures! * Find the party invitations, but watch out for playful Bumpy Dog. * Collect the birthday presents that the Goblins have hidden. * Fly in the aeroplane and ride the Toyland train. * Find the party hats that the mischievious Sly and Gobbo have hidden in the Dark Wood.

Just some of the fun you'll have with Noddy!

- Specifically designed and tested for younger children
- Encourages recognition of left and right, numbers, colours and objects
- Different skill levels cater to a range of abilities and ages from 3 upwards
Not Clickbait!

It started like any other stream. 

Ema ( or Em_tyinside to her fans) went live on Wvtch, unaware that someone else had joined her IRL.

You play as CHAT. Spam the right choices to help Ema escape this intruder!
NSYNC: Get to the Show

With such notable worldwide popularity, it was only a matter of time before the boys of NSYNC got their own handheld video game. Join JC, Justin, Chris, Joey, and Lance in the most daring adventure the group has ever embarked upon, helping them get to the show before curtain time. Of course, life is never easy for these highly sought-after recording artists, so you'll have to help them with such challenges as making snacks and running errands in a stretch limousine. If you can accomplish these feats, you might even get to help the band warm up for their big show with a friendly game of hackey-sack! Packed with challenges and dangerous distractions, the game's real appeal is its goofball spirit and dedication to the band itself. Each of the group's members' distinct personality shines through, making this an awesome title for anyone who likes NSYNC. They might not be the most likely of video game heroes, but have you ever seen a more handsome bunch of characters?
Nushi Tsuri Adventure: Kite no Bouken

"Nushi fishing" series GBC version. While maintaining the heartwarming world view of battle = fishing role-playing game, which is the basic concept, an adventurous element is added. With the motif of pirates, we will cooperate with our friends and sail the continent while considering the ocean currents, wind, and food conditions. The five continents that appear are also Western, Inca, Japanese, and Arctic. You can enjoy the adventure feeling of the world in the field. Fish also appeared as river fish and sea fish, and the first fish in the series also appeared. A cartridge with vibration is used, and the attack and rampage of the fish become vibration and are transmitted to the hand.
Nyghtmare: The Ninth King

Nyghtmare: The Ninth King is a dark-fantasy, classic-vania, action-platform game that aims to make an authentic Game Boy [COLOR] retro feel that is as close as possible to the original. [NES Castlevania and MegaMan!]

The forgotten Kingdom of Mortemire reappeared centuries later, seemingly out of nowhere, it was at this point that a young woman named Aryn awoke alongside the Kingdom, and surprisingly, she seemed unaffected by the unknown call.
With only an iron whip as a weapon, Aryn must make her way through the decaying streets and unravel the mystery that is the Kingdom and its calls.
NYR: New York Race

Throw yourself headlong into a frenetic race at 500 mph through New York of the "Fifth Element"! Take nosedives into the dizzying maze of streets to pick up speed, attack your opponents with fire bonuses, zip past both static and moving obstacles, leaving destruction in your wake. Take your pick from more than 25 airborne vehicles, including the famous taxi and the Police car.
O'Leary Manager 2000

O'Leary Manager 2000 is a football player-manager game released in 2000 for the Game Boy Color. The player can choose whether they want to focus on the management side of football, play the matches themselves on the game's 2D match engine, or combine the two features for a more in-depth experience. It is endorsed by Irish football manager David O'Leary, who was managing Leeds United A.F.C. at the time of the game's release.

The management side of O'Leary Manager 2000 is very comprehensive when compared to similar Game Boy Color games. The player can choose from 240 fully licensed teams from the top two leagues in England, France, Italy, Spain, Germany and the Netherlands to play as or manage, with each team having 16 players in their squad. There is also the option to promote a number of fictional youth team players. However, most of the youth team players are of low ability, so could only realistically be used for back-up when managing a decent quality team.
Oddworld Adventures 2

Abe thought he had saved the Mudokons from the evil Glukkons with the destruction of Rupture Farms. However, a new threat has arisen: the Glukkons who run Soul Storm Brewery have created an addictive drink made from Mudokon bones. To get all of the bones they need, Soul Storm has an army of Mudokon slaves excavating the Mudokon City of Death; when one of the slaves is worked to death, he becomes part of the product. The only person who can put a stop to this is Abe. You will guide Abe as he travels through the brewery and tries to destroy the boilers. Along the way, he must also try to save his people. Luckily, Abe can talk to his people and get them to help defeat the enemies and solve puzzles he faces along the way. Help Abe save the Mudokons in Oddworld Adventures 2.
Office Combat

Office Combat is a game about literally fighting a toxic work culture. Made in GB Studio, you play as a side scrolling worker who wants to leave work on time after finishing their tasks. On the way to the Boss's office, many co-workers stand in your way, and they won't let you go without a fight.
Oha Suta Dance Dance Revolution GB

Oha Suta: Dance Dance Revolution GB blends the millenial superpower of the Dance Dance Revolution series with the popular Japanese kids' show Oha Suta... or Oha Star... the jury's still out on that one. While the track list is limited - only 12 songs in total, with all of those being Oha Suta originals - it also incorporates a collectable card system that utilizes stars you earn by showing us your ultimate dance. I CAN'T STOP CRYING. BUCKETS OF TEARS.
Oha Suta Yama-chan & Raymond

"Oha Suta", which is popular among kids on TV, is now available. A puzzle game in which "Yama-chan & Raymond", who is hosting on TV, becomes the main character, and various gimmicks and robots await the fortress to rescue "Oha Girl" kidnapped by Dr. Oha Mizu. There are 60 stages available. The popular corner "Amidakadapura" familiar from the program is reproduced as it is. Fortune-telling today with three scrolling "Amidakuji".
Oide Rascal

The production masterpiece theater series has appeared in GB, the first is "Rascal the Raccoon". The purpose of the player is to live with Rascal on behalf of the main character and return to the forest a year later. As he gets better at communicating with Rascal, Rascal becomes more and more disciplined. Besides discipline, I also learn various tricks. There are two mini-games, and the points obtained there become items for food and communication. In house making, you can freely choose the remodeling of Rascal's room and the bed.
Ojarumaru: Mitsunegai Jinja no Ennichi de Ojaru!

Turn the fun of the festival into a mini game. If you get a high score in a mini game, you will get a Menko card. Collected Enco Cards can be used to play against friends or exchange Menco. The modes are "Kin-chan's goldfish scooping", "Mike's relaxing quoits", "Sachiyo Usui's yo-yo fishing", "Tommy grandpa's shooting", "Ken's octopus grilling", "Haunted mansion captain's haunted mansion", "Poverty god and twin dog mini" "Golf", "Cold Sai and Ko-chan's fortune-telling", and "Menko card game" are available. Fortune-telling can be printed out with a pocket printer.
Ojarumaru: Tsukiyo ga Ike no Takaramono

A game of the popular NHK educational anime "Ojarumaru". There are 3 modes: "Tabi-dachi niru (single-player mode)", "Tokukun-itashimasu (mini-game mode)", and "Welcome to me (two-player battle mode)". Set in Moonlight Town, the game is played in a sugoroku format, collecting items placed in each square, playing against each other in a mini game, and more when one of them finishes at the pond. The one who collects the points of is the winner.
Operation: Firestorm

Get ready for a thrilling mission through enemy barracks in Operation: Firestorm, a top-down shooting adventure! Dodge enemy fire as you attempt to save your fellow soldiers and destroy the Illuminati Army!
Opossum Country

Opossum Country is a very creepy little Game Boy horror game where a pizza delivery man encounters oddball characters and suspicious behaviour as he makes a delivery to a mysterious trailer park.

Created for the SCREAM FM game jam, in Opossum Country you follow the adventure of a pizza delivery man whose curiosity gets the better of him as he discovers a very strange trailer park during one of his deliveries. The trailer park in question is inhabited by an eclectic bunch of oddball residents and seems to be led by an elusive character called Bill. After an unsuccessful attempt at delivering the pizza you’re keen to leave, but there’s a mysterious girl that you’d like to rescue from this nightmarish place first.

Taking around 15 minutes to play through, it’s an excellent little horror game with a very unsettling atmosphere and an intriguing story that contains some great twists.
Orpheus: To Hell and Back

Orpheus: To Hell and Back is a mesmerizing action-puzzle game that brings the timeless myth of Orpheus and Eurydice to life in the palm of your hands, 80's chibi-anime style! 

Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Greek mythology, wielding the power of music as Orpheus and embark on a daring quest to rescue his beloved Eurydice from the depths of Hades.
Oshinui Tune

Oshinui Tune is a shooter based on a Japanese hiragana fill-in-the-blank puzzle. You must leave the correct first character to complete the word “_shi-nu-i,” and shoot away the incorrect characters. Once the word is complete, the resulting plushie will be created to match it! Complete "OshiNui" to clear the stage
Othello Millennium

It is about 16 times larger than the previous work and has a rich content. You can play against the computer by choosing from 1 to 4 levels. Equipped with modes that help Othello improve, such as a function that waits without returning the battle, a repeat function that allows you to check the battle from the beginning to the end, a focus function that tells you the best place, and an edit function that allows you to start from your favorite shape. In addition, there are plenty of contents such as a two-player battle mode, a quiz mode, and a "dan certification adventure mode" where you can receive dan certification from the Japan Othello Federation.
Ottifanten: Kommando Störtebeker
Ottifanten: Kommando Störtebeker is an auto-running 2D platformer. Baby Bruno goes on a search after his missing teddy bear Honk, through four worlds of six stages each.
Ou Dorobou Jing: Angel Version

The popular comic "King of Bandits JING", which was serialized in "Comic BomBom" until March 1998 and released up to Volume 7, has appeared as a monster breeding simulation RPG. Train and strengthen the monsters you get in battles and events, and acquire various abilities. The battle is a 3v3 team battle. The purpose of the final game is to get the treasure of Aqua Vitae, but even after clearing it, you can enjoy discovering new events and collecting monsters. More than 200 types of monsters can be collected, and more than 30 characters such as friends will appear. You can also exchange monsters with your friends using the communication cable.
Ou Dorobou Jing: Devil Version

The popular comic "King of Bandits JING", which was serialized in "Comic BomBom" until March 1998 and released up to Volume 7, has appeared as a monster breeding simulation RPG. Train and strengthen the monsters you get in battles and events, and acquire various abilities. The battle is a 3v3 team battle. The purpose of the final game is to get the treasure of Aqua Vitae, but even after clearing it, you can enjoy discovering new events and collecting monsters. More than 200 types of monsters can be collected, and more than 30 characters such as friends will appear. You can also exchange monsters with your friends using the communication cable.
Our Forgotten Divine

It's been years since God abandoned us. The world has become an apocalyptic wasteland, and Angels roam free. Twin siblings Aisun and Yoris spend their days scavenging for scraps—until they stumble upon a mysterious colony of robed individuals.

They claim to offer salvation, but something feels off.

Is this truly paradise, or just a deceiving mirage?
Out of Office

Out of Office the Official GameBoy Color Game from Something Corporate.

Based on the album of the same name, Out of Office tells the story of Something Corporate's members and their quest to finally be free of the corporate overlords!

Join Andew and his friends in this GameBoy Color wolrd with some of their hit songs recreated in 8bit for the console!
OutRun GB

What if OutRun came to the Game Boy Color?
The Game Boy never got a version of OutRun back in the 80s. During development of a recent Game Boy game (Hero GP) I wondered if I could fix that and what would it look like? 

The answer to that question is OutRun GB 

OutRun GB is a port of the original Arcade version of Out Run to the Game Boy Color. It's the whole game - all the tracks - all the music - all the wind in your hair !:)

It’s OutRun on a Game Boy \o/

CONTROLS
On a real Game Boy Color or Analogue Pocket:

A - Accelerate
B - Brake?
LEFT and RIGHT - Steer
Owarai Yowiko no Game Michi: Oyaji Sagashite 3 Choume

A game produced by the comedy duo "Yoiko" who is familiar on TV. One day, his son goes on a journey in search of his father who suddenly left behind a note. The stage unfolds from downtown to space to heaven in a ridiculous place. Various incidents occur in the path of his son, and strange characters appear one after another. Fight against the waiting enemies in 30 different sub-games!
P.O.D.: Proof of Destruction

This is a homebrewed game, run on Gameboy Color.

Original version by Shaun Southern - Mastertronic Limited. Commodore 16/Plus4, 1986. Created with GB-Studio 2.0.0 beta5!

Original Story:

P.O.D has no pretentious storyline and no mega-reality to justify its existence. It is simply an exciting addictive shoot-em-up! There are 9 difficult levels to survive, each more difficult than the last and all superbly balanced for playability and action.
You play across an interconnecting grid of wire, along which your P.O.D (what else?) may be moved. The aliens arrive (usually) from the top and descend repidly in orderly fashion, intent on causing P.O.D actual physical pain. You can't move over the damage until it heals (A few second), but the Bad Guys can move!
Each level is timed (20 sec) as shown on the screen and to win through all you have to do is stay in one piece. Should you succeed a bonus extra life (every second level + 1 life - max.
Pac-Man: Special Color Edition

One of the most popular and influential games of the 1980's, Pac-Man stars a little, yellow dot-muncher who works his way around to clear a maze of the various dots and fruit which inhabit the board.

Pac-Man's goal is continually challenged by four ghosts: The shy blue ghost Bashful (Inky), the trailing red ghost Shadow (Blinky), the fast pink ghost Speedy (Pinky), and the forgetful orange ghost Pokey (Clyde). One touch from any of these ghosts means a loss of life for Pac-Man.

Pac-Man can turn the tables on his pursuers by eating of the four Energizers located within the maze. During this time, the ghosts turn blue, and Pac-Man can eat them for bonus points. This only lasts for a limited amount of time, as the ghost's eyes float back to their center box, and regenerate to chase after Pac-Man again.

Survive a few rounds of gameplay, and be treated to humorous intermissions between Pac-Man and the ghosts.
Pachi Pachi Pachi-Slot: New Pulsar Hen

Pachislot "New Pulser" simulation game. In the "research mode" that completely reproduces the actual pachislot "New Pulser", you can freely change the speed of reel rotation, set values, whether or not a flag is established, etc., and you can mark any pattern to make it easier to press. It has a "push marker" function. In "Story Mode" where the story progresses with pachislot, the purpose is to defeat the Pachislot Great Demon King who aims to conquer the pachislot world in a bonus city where people who cannot live without pachislot live.
Pachinko CR Mouretsu Genjin T

The popular platform "CR Moretsu Primitive Man T", which has gained overwhelming support from pachinko fans, is finally here. You can select a store on the map screen of the city, and in the store you can select a table by examining the nails on the up screen of the board. You can fully enjoy the fun actions unique to the reach and jackpot "Moretsu Primitive Man" on the enlarged screen. Of course, the prize money won can be carried over to the next time using a password.
Pachinko Hissou Guide: Data no Ousama

With this, the data analysis that is indispensable for pachinko capture is okay! Introduced "Pachicode", a system only for the king of data that allows easy input of actual machine data! You can easily grasp the data of any actual machine. Also, since it is a Game Boy that is easy to carry, you can easily check information anytime, anywhere! In addition to the database, you can hit SANKYO's popular model "CR Fever Crazy Combat SR" as a pachinko game, or play an adventure game in story mode.
Panel de Pon GB

Panel de Pon GB is an unreleased port of Intelligent Systems's flagship puzzle series for GameBoy Color.

A lot of the build got transformed to become Pokemon Puzzle Challenge, but a lot of the original data remains underneath the front-end. A demo can be accessed using a specific set of inputs depending whether you are running this on a GameBoy Color or other prior GameBoy systems.

There has been an ongoing project to restore the game to its original intended presentation.
Paperboy

In PAPERBOY, all you have to do is deliver the newspaper to your subscribers. While this sounds easy enough, obstacles seem to constantly get into your way...things like dogs, kids on tricycles, traffic, and pedestrians. Since this is your neighborhood, you want punish those who do not subscribe to your paper, so you break their windows with rolled up newspapers. You will even hear the glass shatter thanks to the digitized sound effects and music! At the end of each level there is a bonus course, where you can demonstrate your newspaper-flinging accuracy and earn bonus points. Fortunately, there are three difficulty levels to help you get accustomed to the controls of the game. Will you become the master of your neighborhood or just another punk on a bike? Play PAPERBOY and find out.
Papyrus
Papyrus is an Action game, developed by Planet Interactive and published by Ubisoft, which was released in Europe in 2000.
Parodius

A colorized re-release of the Game Boy classic. This Game Boy Color version of the game was originally released as part of the Konami GB Collection Volume 2. Standalone versions exist thanks to the romhacking community.
Parrot
Paws & Perils: Out Of This World

The world of Terranimalium was a peaceful and diverse world filled with biomes and animals of every kind… No wonder the aliens would want to take it- But you and your friends aren’t going to let that happen! Traverse the planet as one of six characters to find a spaceship that can take down the alien’s fleet before it’s too late!
PaZeek
SkyRank Games scrapped this game and moved on to GBA development, they wrote "The wait is over, PaZeek GBC is NOW available for download. The game is 85% complete with more then 50 playable levels."
Perfect Choro Q

While Perfect Choro Q is a racing game, it does not control the same way as most racing games. Perfect Choro Q is turn based racing and controls much like a golf game. The player takes turns with the computer opponents, which starts out with the player choosing which direction the car will go in (which is represented by a dotted line.) Once the desired direction is chosen then the power will be chosen by pressing the A button to stop the moving power meter.

Perfect Choro Q also has some role-playing elements in that the player drives a car along an overworld map and has multiple destinations that can be chosen.
Perfect Dark

Joanna Dark has almost finished her training, but she isn't a Carrington Institute agent just yet. She has only one test left - but this time, her mission is for real. In it, she will uncover a far-reaching conspiracy that will introduce her to the shadowy dataDyne Corporation and hint at things to come... From the creators of GoldenEye for the N64 comes Rare's masterpiece... Perfect Dark.

Lots of ways to play! Snipe from long range, commandeer an enemy vehicle - even shoot from a first-person view.

Multiplayer games! Link up and get blown away with eight 2-player games and a total of 35 maps. (Game Link cable sold separately.)

Huge bosses! From helicopters to giant cyborg spiders, go up against some of the most intimidating bosses ever to appear on Game Boy.

Amazing voice and sound! Hear more digitized voices and sound effects in Perfect Dark than in any other handheld game.
Petris

Petris - A puzzle game of shapely pets for the Game Boy Color (not compatible with original/pocket)

Build your favorite pets in all shapes and sizes, keep ahead of dropping pieces and make it to the next level!

Game Types
Try out a variety game play modes with different incentives and strategies:

Long Pet: Complete progressively longer pets to reach the next level.
Tails Cleanup: Clear all tails off the screen per level
Crunch-up: Keep ahead as the screen crunches upward and new pets appear
Level Up: Classic level-up style
Marathon: For the long distance player
Head-to-Head 2 Player
Two players can compete over Game Boy Link Cable (CGB and GBA) in all game types.
* Send crunch-ups to your opponent when you complete long pets or level-up. The last player standing wins the match.
Phantom Zona

In Phantom Zona, the player is invited to a school where solving puzzles is the most popular pastime. Upon arriving however, the player will meet Phantom Zona, who reveals that the school is actually a secret base for a gang that fights each other using riddles. When the player enters a battle, he or she is presented with a riddle, and multiple choices answers. Answering correctly will damage the opponent. Answering wrong causes damage to the player. Whoever has the least amount of damage wins. The game makes use of the Game Boy Color's infra-red port. By using anything that emits a infra-red signal, the game generates new puzzles. Players can also use the Game Boy Link cable to swap puzzles.
Pia Carrot e Youkoso!! 2.2

In the dating simulation Pia Carrot e Yōkoso!!, the player controls Yusuke Kinoshita, a 18-year-old male Japanese high-school student. He intends to have a cool summer vacation, but realizes he has no money. Having no choice, he takes a job in his father's restaurant, "Pia Carrot". Thus begins an adventure much more exciting than the summer vacation he has dreamed about: he gets to know many beautiful girls in the restaurant, and has to decide which one is the love of his life...
Piecrust

Piecrust is a logic puzzle game for the Game Boy Color based on Nanogram / Picross. 

Each row and column in a grid has a series of numbers. These refer to number of adjacent squares that should be filled. Each block of solid squares are separated by one or more unfilled squares. Blocks of solid squares can start anywhere in a row or column.
Pilgrim's Peril
Roguelike dungeon-crawler game for the Game Boy.
Pine Creek

The disappearance of a young girl in the previously quiet small town of Pine Creek raises the popular belief that a cult is behind the crime and many other ritual killings before her. 

Her best friend will do his best to solve why, how, and who is behind it.

PINE CREEK is an adventure game focused on exploration, story, and following clues. Have friends, think about life, think about death, eat tasty food, and play games in the arcade!

The project started out as a Game Boy game before being colorized in late 2020 and brought to the Game Boy Color platform. The Game Boy Color version remains completely backwards compatible with the original Game Boy.
Pitfall: Beyond the Jungle

Swing into non-stop action with Pitfall Harry Jr. on Game Boy Color!

Plunge into a magical rift within the steaming jungles of South America to enter a new dimension filled with treachery. Guide young Pitfall Harry Jr. as he swings, leaps and combats deadly creatures to protect the Moku people from evil Scourge.

- 15 treacherous levels filled with traps and treasure.
- Wield your trusty pick axe and swing across gaping chasms on a vine.
- Magmoids, Demon Bats and Fire Djinns are only the beginning of the horrible monsters awaiting you.
- Devious traps like vanishing floors, moving platforms and bubbling lava line your path to glory.
Planet of the Apes

Released in conjunction with the 2001 cinematic remake, PLANET OF THE APES, the game actually takes its plot from the 1968 original film. Play as Ulysses (the character that Charlton Heston originated), a human who has fallen to a post-apocalyptic Earth ruled by primates. Ulysses quickly discovers that he is being considered a sort of messiah by many of the apes (he's considered an enemy by others), and it is becoming readily apparent that the creatures want him to save them from the dangers of this new world. The game is packed with puzzles to solve, and the graphics are among the best ever created for the Game Boy Color. Modes of play include: Normal, in which Ulysses walks from location to location; Athletic, in which the hero runs and jumps through each level of the story; and Stealth, which requires Ulysses to crawl and slink into hidden areas not accessible in other modes. It's not easy to compare PLANET OF THE APES to any other video game, and that's really its charm.
Player Manager 2001

Player Manager 2001 is the Game Boy Color version of the long running football management series that started on the Amiga in 1989. It follows the norm of the genre and lets you take control of any team in the top two divisions of five European countries (England, France, Germany, Spain and Italy). As the manager it is your task to buy and sell players, lay up training schedules, set contracts and scout for new players. Most importantly, your job is to choose the right squad, and create tactics that takes advantage of your opponents' weaknesses. There are different staff modes meaning that you can choose to put some parts of the game as auto. The matches are text based.
Pocket Billiard Funk: The 9 Ball

An adult game, billiards arranged in a cute pop. In addition to full-scale billiards, it is equipped with the original game system "Tamappy" that takes advantage of the characteristics of Game Boy. In billiards called club nine-ball, you can usually enjoy 9 balls, but there is also a tamappy mode where you can play games using spirits hidden in billiards called tamappies and items called tamappies. While honing your billiard skills, you can collect and exchange tamappies and tamappies.
Pocket Bomberman

Long, long ago, the sun was covered by a dark and heavy cloud. It was said this cloud was caused by a monster that had sealed the Sword of the Sun. Legends also says that to break the seal, a hero must collect five Power Stones that are guarded by monsters. Bomberman takes up the challenge as he is the last hero strong enough to defeat such monsters.

This is a side-scrolling platform game. In each world, you must clear four areas by killing any monsters within. To kill a monster, you drop a bomb. After a few seconds, the bomb explodes in a four-way blast. If the monster is within range of the blast, it is killed. After you clear these four areas, you must clear a fifth area by killing a boss to clear the world and collect its Power Stone.

Be careful, though, because if Bomberman is touched by a monster, touches a dangerous item or is caught in the blast of his own bomb, you lose a life. After all lives are gone, you get the option to restart that last area or quit.
Pocket Bowling

The action and excitement of using a big ball to knock down white pins comes to the Game Boy Color with POCKET BOWLING. Make your selection from six different bowlers, including an android. Once you have a bowler that matches your style of play, use the Training mode to work on picking up spares and to get the hang of the game controls. When you are ready for some action, play against a human or computer opponent in the Standard mode. If you want an extra challenge, try to win a tournament against four opponents in four different alleys. In all of the modes, getting the perfect shot requires lining it up, setting the proper amount of spin and power, and letting the ball go at the right time. Play POCKET BOWLING, and become master of the lanes.
Pocket Color Billiards
Pocket Color Billiard is a Sports game, published by Bottom Up, which was released in Japan in 1999.
Pocket Color Mahjong

A four-player mahjong that you can hit with a unique character. You can choose a member from 12 people, such as cheap, full-fledged professionals, and screaming. Communication battles are possible using a communication cable. You can enjoy full-scale mahjong with an advanced thinking circuit.
Pocket Color Trump
Realistic play with communication cable settings. You can enjoy 5 types of games: "Millionaire", "Speed", "Page One", "Dobon", and "Blackjack".
Pocket Cooking

A cooking simulation game where you practice cooking with your helper "Food Angel". The purpose is to make the restaurant prosper, aiming to be a true chef in order to revive the leaning restaurant. Select ingredients from the storage location and reproduce the actual work such as cutting, simmering, stir-frying, and seasoning in the game to complete the dish. Set the menu considering the price of food, the number of dishes, etc., and open the shop. If the customer's reaction is bad, the store's reputation will decline, the number of customers will decrease, and events such as eating away will occur. Occupations are Japanese, Western, Chinese, and ethnic. Cultivation of ingredients in the garden at home and cooking confrontation with rivals. You can exchange original dishes with your friends using the communication cable.
Pocket Densha 2

This time, with the cooperation of Odakyu Electric Railway and Nankai Electric Railway, Odakyu Romance Car, Nankai Rapi: t, etc. will appear. Beginner's subway mode, and after clearing, new routes will appear and there will be plenty of content! The expression of landscapes and curves that could not be expressed in the previous work, the coloring of trains, etc. have been greatly enhanced. You can enjoy the scenery of Odawara Castle, Hakone Mountain, Kansai Airport, and Koyasan. The site view is also powered up. In addition to the stations, you can enjoy tunnels, railway bridges, and elevated tracks from the site view.
Pocket Family GB2

The second family development simulation in which the player takes care of the family who moved in as a landlord. This time, the number of owners has increased from one to four, and it has become possible to visit the house with a lopo. You can get items in the mini game "Walking in the back mountains", and you can enjoy various things such as equipping the lopo parts with lopo parts and planting flower seeds in the flowerbed. Five types of mini-games that improve the abilities of the family and four types of care games that improve the intimacy with the family have been created. The number of characters appearing this time has increased to about 300 types for album creation. Take care of many characters and fill the album.
Pocket GI Stable

A horse racing game that anyone can play, whether it's a horse racing freak or a horse racing beginner. There are three ways to play: training mode, training mode, and original stakes. In the training mode, you will train a racehorse as a trainer and compete with a little less than 10,000 rival horses that have entered the race based on the Central Horse Racing, aiming to win the Derby Horse, Triple Crown Horse, and All G1. In the breeding mode, a racehorse that you want to make is involved from the seeding stage, and a type of game that raises electronic pets such as taking care of a mother horse, giving birth, taking care of a foal, and training to become a racehorse. In the original stakes mode, you can register the horses you raised and race them, or you can enjoy the race with your friends using a communication cable or password.
Pocket Hanafuda

Perform a "Hanafuda game" with 12 unique characters. The Hanafuda game is played by selecting two types of games, "Flower Matching" and "Koi-Koi". The player plays 12 games with each character, and the one with the most wins advances to the next. And if you win all the characters, it will be the ending! !! Of course, it is also possible to play "Flower Matching" and "Koi-Koi" alone.
Pocket King

A fantasy simulation game that inherits the pedigree of the masterpiece "King of Kings". There are plenty of original elements such as more than 150 types of units and characters such as humans, fairies, and dragons, 179 types of special skills, "class change" items and "party formation" that strengthen the units! You can also exchange units with friends using a communication cable, and you can enjoy the collection to complete the unit picture book. Not only those who are addicted to "King of Kings" but also those who are new to the series can enjoy it widely.
Pocket Lure Boy

The goal is for the player to become a boy who loves fishing, acquire lures and fishing techniques while competing with rivals in various places, and finally win the "legendary fisherman" in the fishing game. You can create a "fish picture book" by releasing the fish you caught during the adventure to your own lake. There are 60 kinds of fish that appear in the game! Collecting all of these is also one of the players' goals. Also, if you use a communication cable, you can play fishing games and exchange lures and fish with your friends.
Pocket Monsters Go! Go!

Monster Go! Go! Go!! is a hack of The Smurfs 3 released in the late 1990s for the Game Boy Color. The Smurfs 3 was originally in monochrome, but was colorized in this hack - it was later re-released officially in color as The Smurfs Nightmare, and a subsequent version of the hack was based on this release.

Almost all the graphics from the original game are replaced, and so does the intro and ending text. Bizarrely, the intro text appears to be replaced with a poorly translated version of My Heart Will Go On by Céline Dion. Aside from the title screen, the game's use of color is limited, which gives it the appearance of a Super Game Boy game. The game suffers from extreme slowdown, running consistently at about half speed, possibly due to the colorization process.
Pocket Music

Make music on the move with Pocket Music, the music creation game. Create your own music from a selection of samples, drum beats, baselines, melodies, and other musical instruments. Play them back, save them to your cartridge, or swap them with a friend. Features include more than 600 different high quality samples and instruments, custom drumbeats, baselines, melodies and sound effects, a riff editor to allow you to create your own sounds, and prearranged tracks to demonstrate the capabilities of the game.
Pocket no Naka no Oukoku

Pocket no Naka no Oukoku (ポケットの中の王国, Kingdom in Your Pocket) is a hybrid adventure/simulation game by Hect, best known as the developers of Moon Crystal. It's also possibly the most obscure commercially developed Game Boy game in existence.

The leaked game identifies itself internally as version 0.950, built on March 7th, 2001, and I would estimate that it's 75-80% done; it can be played from start to finish, but the last few areas are obviously incomplete and it has several glaring bugs.
Pocket of Horror

What if WORLD OF HORROR was released on the Game Boy Color?
Four MYSTERIES, and the old LIGHTHOUSE
Many PALETTES to choose from
CHARACTERS with different stats
A rough approximation of combat, events, items, etc
Pocket Pro Wrestling: Perfect Wrestler

A versatile handheld wrestling game, with over 20 different moves and a 3D enviroment to utilize every corner and sides of the ring. A roster of 12 wrestlers go against each other for the championship.
Pocket Pro Yakyuu

The game development just like an actual professional baseball game is reproduced on the screen. In one-player play, you can play pennant races or play against computers. Communication battle is possible with two people. Pennant race can be selected up to 135 games. You can play up to 4-7 games in the Japan Series. Both professional baseball Central League players are officially recognized by the Nippon Professional Baseball Organization and appear with their real names and data. Infrared input from remote control signals of household appliances changes the player's parameters. There are 45 registered players per team (30 fielders, 15 pitchers). Foreign player participation rules, etc. also comply with the "official baseball rules". The edit function also supports sudden trades and the addition of foreign players. Fictitious trades and dream team creation are also possible by changing the player name.
Pocket Puyo Puyo Sun

Puyo Puyo Sun is the third entry in the main Puyo Puyo series of real-time puzzle games, its title being a pun involving the Japanese word for "three". The evil Dark Prince has caused the sun to augment its size and power to dangerous levels, and thus the Puyo Puyo world is on the verge of being scorched unless you prevent it.

The game features three distinct story campaigns, each pitting you against a different set of enemies which you must battle in classic Puyo Puyo fashion: In each stage you face off against an opponent in two different play areas, one for you and one for your opponent. As the blob-like "puyos" start falling in your play area, you must align them and create groups of the same color in order to clear the screen before you get flooded with puyos.
Pocket Puyo Puyo~n

This time Puyo talks! Introduced the long-awaited "chain voice" to GB. The voices of "Ei!", "Fire!", And "Ice Storm!", Which are familiar at the event, will make the battle even more exciting. Equipped with "official battle mode". Bet a sign with your name on it and fight in online battles. If you win the online match, the rank of "Puyo class" will rise and the official handicap will be calculated automatically. With this, even beginners who can not make chains and advanced players who can make big chains can experience a close battle.
Pocket Racing
Pocket Racing is a racing game, which was released in Japan in 1999.
Pocket Smash Out

Pocket Smash Out is based on the classic multi-level arcade / puzzle game ‘BREAKOUT’ with the various levels all themed with exciting Manga graphics. The levels become progressively harder as you work your way through all of the 16+ levels. There are over 90 different brick layout patterns in the Championship and with the harder levels being kept till last there is more than enough challenge for even the most experienced player. The object of the game is to ‘fire’ your ball at the bricks and catch it on the rebound (watch out for those bonus balls !!) and progress to the next level.
Pocket Smash Out & Race Time

"Pocket Smash Out" and "Race Time" are two separate game titles that were released together as a "Mega Value Double Pack" for the Game Boy Color. The release date for this compilation was February 23, 2001. "Pocket Smash Out" is a Breakout-style game with manga-themed graphics and challenging levels, while "Race Time" is likely a racing game.
Pocket Soccer

It's time to show your soccer skills! Pocket Soccer brings the world's most popular sport direct to the palm of your hand. Create your own team from more than 200 players or choose from 32 ready made teams, then work your way up the league in this fast paced game! Play head-to-head with a friend using the Universal Game Link cable (sold separately) or trade players in order to make your team the very best!
PocketWare
PocketWare is a microgame collection for the Game Boy Color in the vein of WarioWare. A submission for the GBCompo25.
Pokemon Crooked Crystal

Pokemon Crooked Crystal is a reimagining of the classic Pokemon Crystal, designed to enhance gameplay while preserving its nostalgic charm. For example, HM03 Surf is now a Key Item—the Lapras Suit—though a reusable TM for Surf remains available at the same time.

The story takes an intriguing turn: After losing a rigged bet on the Bug Catching Contest, Professor Elm mired in debt, refuses to pay Team Rocket. Tasked with raising a Pokémon to protect Elm, you’ll travel through Johto, earning Gym Badges, exposing Team Rocket’s corruption, and unraveling their deeper, more sinister plans.

This hack introduces a more diverse set of wild and trainer Pokémon, an expanded and intensified Team Rocket/Radio Tower plotline, added lore about Kanto’s limited map, and plenty more surprises in this more challenging version of Crystal.
Pokemon Crystal 16-bit
This is a Crystal hack updated to handle 16-bit indexes with various new additions. It has over 700 Pokemon with over 600 moves, PSS systems, Fairy Type, Randomized Starters, and more!
Pokemon Orange

You are a kid from Valencia Island who wants to become a Pokémon Master, after hearing about a kid the same age named Red defeating the Indigo League 6 months ago. You set out on a journey to deliver the mysterious GS Ball to the esteemed Samson Oak, who is visiting the Orange Islands from the Alola region and to take on the Orange Crew! Play as Indigo or Orange, explore, fight goofy villains, and walk into a fresh and nostalgic world to learn more about the wonderful world of Pokémon and to Catch ’em All!
Pokettohiro!

A group of brave heroes must gather the fragments of the Magic Crystal to face the evil Black Knight and thus prevent the destruction of the kingdom. But it will not be an easy task, for this they will have to overcome countless obstacles, defeat huge monsters and visit all kinds of places. Will these little heroes be able to restore peace to the kingdom?
Pokimals! - A Roguelite Adventure

Deal with the strange and insane inhabitants of The Island as you explore a series of ruins that were discovered beneath the surface.

It's your 13th birthday, so the government says you're old enough to die in a hole! (It's all in the name of adventure, so it's cool.)

Pick from one of 13 starters and make your way into the depths of The Ruins. Defeat 5 critters and the door will open, and the ruins may give up some of their loot. Do you use it to boost your team or sell it for supplies? As you defeat your instructors at The Site, you'll unlock more ANIMALs in The Ruins as well as more resources for your excursions!

Use a clean, Version 1.1 Pokemon Crystal ROM for patching.
Pokémon Adventure

Pokémon Adventure is a bootleg platformer released for Game Boy Color in 2000 by Makon Soft. This game turns out to be a hack of Sonic Adventure 7, which possibly makes it the first game to hack an existing hack, Sonic Adventure 7 being a hack of Sonic 3D Blast 5 on the Game Boy.

The intro in the game features screenshots of specific Pokémon entries from Pokémon Gold's Japanese Pokédex, complete with the actual Japanese descriptions for each. The borders change with each entry as each screen is a four-color BG image instead of being comprised of various sprites and BGs like in the official Pokédex from Pokémon Gold, Pokémon Silver and Pokémon Crystal.
Pokémon Ambrosia
